title: Attest report v2
description: Test run report written by `pytest --attest-report=<path>`, the Vitest AttestReporter `outputFile` and the engine report generator. Read by `attest policy evaluate`, `attest baseline` and the pr-annotate action. `results` holds one row per assertion; `tests` holds one row per test with its outcome and source location.

id_scheme.description: Assertion id scheme of results[].assertion_id. 2 is contract C3: `a2_` plus the first 32 hex characters of SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 array [scope_id, assertion_type, canonical_spec, occurrence_index]; the exact recipe is in protocol-spec.md (Assertion ids) and the golden vectors are protocol-tests/ids/assertion-ids.json. A report without the field uses scheme 1 (ordinal or random ids). `attest policy evaluate --baseline` exits 3 when the baseline is not scheme 2.

budget_exceeded.description: True when any evaluate_batch of the run returned budget_exceeded, that is, the engine session passed ATTEST_MAX_SOFT_FAILURES. Every result is still present. `attest policy evaluate` blocks on it.

summary.description: Assertion counts by status. not_evaluated is counted separately and excluded from pass rates (contract C1).

tests_collected.description: Tests collected after deselection. pytest counts it independently of the rows in `tests`; the Vitest reporter derives it from the task tree it reports. `attest policy evaluate` exits 3 when this is above 0 and `tests` is empty.

traces.description: Evaluated traces keyed by trace id, each a trace-v2 document. Written only when ATTEST_REPORT_TRACES=1 (traces hold prompts, outputs and tool arguments); read by `attest view`. Rows reference an entry through trace_id.

usage.description: Attest-initiated model usage of evaluate_batch calls (L5 embeddings, L6 judges, judge repeats, bias probes): model calls · tokens (cached) · $ · retry cost. Agent calls not routed through attest are not counted.

judge_calls.description: Judge-provider requests, the part of model_calls that max_judge_calls limits.

replay_summary.description: Model calls the run's fixture-bound tests served from fixtures (replayed) and sent to a provider (live). Absent when no test ran in replay mode. Unlike usage, which counts only attest-initiated calls, these are the agent's own calls through the replay proxy. live_cost_usd prices live calls whose model has a built-in price; unpriced_live_calls counts the rest.

replay_test.description: How one fixture-bound test was served. misses counts requests that matched no recording; miss is the first miss message.

file.description: Test source file, relative to the test runner's root directory, with forward slashes.

result.description: One assertion result. test_id, file and line locate the test that requested it; rows from the engine report generator, which has no test context, omit them.

scope_id.description: C3 scope of the assertion id: the test node id, or the ContinuousEvalRunner name outside tests. With type and spec_hash it lets a baseline comparison report a spec edit as changed instead of removed (C4).

spec_hash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the assertion spec's RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical form. The engine computes it and echoes scope_id from the evaluate_batch assertion.

trial.description: 1-based trial index when the test ran as fixed-N trials; rows of one assertion share assertion_id across trials.

trace_id.description: Key into the top-level traces map of the trace this row was evaluated against; present only with ATTEST_REPORT_TRACES=1.

test.description: One test and its outcome under the aggregation rules (contract C1).

not_evaluated_reasons.description: Distinct reasons of the test's not_evaluated assertions, in first-seen order.

trials.description: Number of fixed-N trials the test ran; absent for a single run.
